title: Teen Beauty Spend Is Up, as Is Rhode’s Stock, Piper Sandler Survey Shows
summary: The brand — led by Hailey Bieber and backed by E.l.f. Beauty — entered Piper Sandler’s annual Teen Survey for the first time this year, as skin care and cosmetics spend rose 5 percent.

extraction.key_fact: Rhode가 처음으로 Piper Sandler 청소년 설문에 올랐고 청소년의 뷰티 지출이 늘었다.
